name: Triad — Epoch‑Ignition Stability Surfaces
summary: Defines the stability surfaces of epoch‑ignition behavior, including ignition‑epoch stability fields, ignition‑epoch stabilization surfaces, ignition‑epoch load‑bearing geometry, and multi‑layer ignition‑epoch stability binding.
purpose: Provide the stability-surface geometry used by Scanner, O.H.S.H.I.T., and Atlas to stabilize epoch‑ignition waves, maintain ignition integrity across propagation routes, reinforce ignition fronts, and bind epoch‑level ignition stability across the Triad pipeline.
